instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a bright office interior next to large windows. On the left, the woman in the striped blazer (R1) sits on a gold wire chair, profile facing right, holding a white coffee cup with both hands. On the right, the man in the floral short-sleeve shirt (R2) sits facing her, gesturing with his right hand while holding a coffee cup in his left hand. They sit opposite each other across a small round marble table, actively conversing. Bright, natural light fills the space, maintaining a clean, neutral color palette with a shallow depth of field.
